# About this book {.unnumbered}

This is a reformatted edition of *Python for Everybody: Exploring Data Using
Python 3* by Charles R. Severance, prepared for use in a business-school
introductory Python course. The original book, its videos, and its
autograded exercises are free at <https://www.py4e.com/>.

Some chapters and exercises have been added or adapted for this course.
Where a chapter comes from the original book, it is reproduced under the
book's Creative Commons
[Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/)
license; see the *Copyright Detail* appendix.
